mode: synthetic renderer reads; outside requests blocked; no real votes or comments posted
checks: existing poll opens its dedicated discussion only on explicit click
unknown discussion records remain read-only and are not assigned feed or author permissions
pagination failure retains loaded discussions and repeats the failed request unchanged
closing or switching poll hides old rows and suppresses its late result
verification replays the exact read; switching account suppresses old verification replay
empty vote discussions are explicit and no test issued a mutation
